1. About This Cookie Policy

This Cookie Policy explains how AmplifyIQ uses cookies and similar technologies on amplifyiq.ie.

It should be read together with our Privacy Policy.

2. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small pieces of information stored on or accessed from a user's device when visiting a website.

Websites may also use technologies similar to cookies, including:

  • local storage;
  • pixels;
  • tags;
  • scripts;
  • tracking identifiers; and
  • software-development or analytics technologies.

For convenience, this policy refers to these technologies collectively as "cookies".

3. Types of Cookies We Use

Our website may use the following categories.

Strictly Necessary Cookies

These cookies are required for essential website functionality or security.

They may be used for purposes including:

  • security;
  • fraud prevention;
  • network management;
  • consent preferences;
  • form functionality;
  • session management; and
  • technical website operation.

These cookies cannot normally be disabled through our consent tool where they are genuinely necessary to provide the website or a service requested by the user.

Functional Cookies

Functional cookies may provide enhanced features or remember choices made by a user.

Examples can include:

  • interface preferences;
  • language preferences;
  • embedded third-party features; and
  • enhanced website functionality.

Where consent is legally required for a functional technology, it will remain disabled until consent has been provided.

Analytics Cookies

Analytics cookies help us understand how visitors interact with the website.

They may provide information concerning:

  • visitor numbers;
  • traffic sources;
  • pages visited;
  • time spent on pages;
  • website interactions;
  • device types; and
  • website performance.

Analytics cookies will not be activated until the user has provided the required consent.

Marketing and Advertising Cookies

Marketing technologies may be used to:

  • measure advertising campaigns;
  • track conversions;
  • measure interactions with advertisements;
  • build advertising audiences; or
  • provide relevant advertising.

Marketing and advertising cookies will not be activated unless the required consent has been obtained.

4. Third-Party Technologies

Where enabled, our website may use third-party services such as:

  • website analytics services;
  • advertising platforms;
  • social-media integrations;
  • video or media providers;
  • scheduling tools;
  • contact-form providers; or
  • other website functionality.

The exact providers used by the live AmplifyIQ website may change.

The Cookie Settings panel must display the current technologies deployed on the website.

5. Cookie Details

AmplifyIQ provides information about individual cookies and tracking technologies through the panel.

For each cookie or similar technology, the website should display, where applicable:

  • cookie or storage name;
  • provider;
  • category;
  • purpose;
  • duration or expiry;
  • whether it is first-party or third-party; and
  • any relevant additional information.

This list must reflect the actual technologies in use on the website.

6. Your Cookie Choices

When you first visit our website, you may be presented with a cookie-consent banner.

You will be able to:

Accept All

Allows all cookie categories permitted by your selection.

Reject Non-Essential

Keeps optional analytics, advertising and other non-essential technologies disabled.

Manage Preferences

Allows you to choose individual categories of optional cookies.

No non-essential category should be enabled by default.

7. Changing or Withdrawing Consent

You can change your cookie choices at any time using the link available in the website footer.

Withdrawing consent should be as easy as giving consent.

Changing your selection will prevent future use of technologies covered by the withdrawn consent.

Where technically possible, cookies previously created by our website in those categories should also be removed.

8. Cookie Consent Duration

Your consent choice may be stored using a strictly necessary preference cookie so that the website remembers your selection.

Users should periodically be asked to reaffirm their cookie choices.

AmplifyIQ's implementation should normally request renewed consent no later than approximately six months after the previous consent choice, unless a different period is objectively justified.

Consent should also be requested again where there is a material change to:

  • the cookies used;
  • the purposes for which they are used;
  • the providers involved; or
  • the consent categories.

9. Browser Controls

Most web browsers also allow users to control or delete cookies through browser settings.

Disabling certain cookies through browser settings may affect website functionality.

Browser controls operate separately from the consent controls provided by AmplifyIQ.

10. Changes to this Cookie Policy

This policy may be updated as:

  • technologies change;
  • service providers change;
  • website functionality changes; or
  • legal requirements change.

The latest version will be available on this page.

11. Contact

For questions concerning our use of cookies, contact:
